to get to nothingness easier just go to an infant stage, remeber when u were new born or foetus, you just were, you seeked nothing, prefered nothing, dislike nothing, you chose nothing as well as embraced everything, do that en literally force your brain to imprint those en be those, slowly your mind will rewire en slowly you will turn to be one who runs on those principles, dont stop seek to have them swallow you, force you to wear those principle then you will get your enlightment or so called awakening the true awakening which is one that when you look inside for who you are all you will find is you are nothing, yep thats its. 

I cant really advice anyfurther than that, because thats where i am, but im not pure such thats because my way is of defiance, defiance of why should i bend to rule or laws, what makes the laws or rule worthy to decide how should i be, what me me unworthy that i should bend to anything, so my will is extreme, life is to be embraced en life forms are to be nurtured en allowed to grow unendlessly why should they be supressed en be reborn constantly as humans or animals, who is worthy to decide what life suffer or which don't, what makes them worthy in the first place. 

yes so thats why even though im nothing by nature because deep in me nothingness has swallowed me unlike bhuddism practitioners i dont let me seek to be deeply engulf by nothingness state, but im constantly growing en battling, yes i can enter spirit world, yes I know how its like to be in un attached state of existance there, been through it at times. en yes i kill there have few times en have suffered the fate but above all i just mostly heal or ressurect sometimes, basically my path en my principles unlike those who do pure nothingness state mine has continued to path of battles en conquire, while if i did nothingness more then i would likely just be more peaceful en enter state of non interferance. 

My path started with difiance en unwilling to accept that i never chose eatlest everything i dont remeber choosing conciusly, state of nothingness found me not long ago but by then i was already kinda self established in spirit world a little, perhaps thats why i dont look much into it, thats because i dont need it, my path is of supreme or nothing but nothing is never a choice so i can only grow. Hence i say all path leads same place but the principle are similar so find your path en doing things to benbefits of others helps more than doing it for yourself, if i was battling for me i would have long won en stopped, but its not about me but me en us because we are one.
